text:
sophie (People Ops): quick check-in for @alex.newhire  welcome! a few cross-border onboarding items before Day 1 (Tue):
- I-9: international hires without SSN can complete Section 1 now; Section 2 must be done within 3 business days. we can set up an on-site verifier or use one of our local partners.
- background check: Veriscan asked for local police certificate — upload scanned PDF to the portal or attach here.
- payroll & tax: you can start work; payroll will finalize once SSN is provided.

alex.newhire: thanks @sophie. i don't have the police certificate yet. can i start remotely and bring passport for Section 2 when i arrive? also, tracking shows my laptop stuck at customs.

sophie (People Ops): yes, start remotely is fine. schedule Section 2 within 3 days of your arrival to SF. if customs delays hardware, we can arrange a temporary loaner for you at the office on Day 1.

mike (IT): looping in IT — @alex.newhire what's your laptop model preference for a loaner? MacBook Pro or ThinkPad? i can pre-provision VPN and SSO. also please run this check once you have network access:
```
curl -fsS https://internal.redwood.ai/health || echo "vpn-check-failed"
```

alex.newhire: MacBook Pro would be ideal. ran the health check from hotel wifi and got "ok".

veriscan-bot: Veriscan portal update sent to alex.newhire at alex@example.com. Action required: upload local police certificate or select "exemption" with a supporting note.

lena (Benefits): heads up on benefits paperwork: for overseas domestic partner coverage we need notarized partner affidavit and translation. if that's not ready, enrollments can be backdated within 30 days of proof. i can DM the template.

alex.newhire: please DM the template. also the customs note shows "missing invoice"  courier asked for employer tax ID. is that something you can provide?

courier-bot: Courier update for package PKG-7814: delivery held - missing commercial invoice. Please provide company tax ID to customs: 94-1234567. Contact: globalcourier@example.com, ref CUS-1023.

sophie (People Ops): we've sent the employer tax ID to courier. shipping ETA updated to next morning. mike, please keep loaner ready in case hardware arrives late.

mike (IT): loaner reserved: MacBook Pro (serial LOAN-903). i'll create IT ticket IT-3021 and preinstall Zoom, Slack, VPN. alex, i'll add you to the wifi guest list and drop credentials in the portal.

alex.newhire: all good, thanks everyone. one more Q: Veriscan asked for a scanned signature page and wants me to sign with DocuSign. anything special to watch for?

sophie (People Ops): only sign documents coming from veriscan.io or our verified vendor domains. if in doubt, paste the sender email here before signing. otherwise go ahead.

alex.newhire: signed and uploaded the police cert (PDF). portal now shows "submitted". excited to join!

sophie (People Ops): great — marked background check as submitted. final ask: please complete W-4 + direct deposit in the payroll portal by Friday to avoid the first-pay delay. we'll post Day 1 agenda tomorrow. welcome aboard :tada:
